verdict.rationale: Postman ships a documented, discoverable REST API (postman-docs-5, confirmed live via OpenAPI spec probe-3) that lets users programmatically manage collections, environments, workspaces, mocks, and more, plus a CLI (postman-docs-5/6/19) and MCP server (postman-probe-4) for automation and CI/CD — strong evidence of broad API/UI parity for core objects. However, there's no explicit confirmation that every UI capability (e.g., Flows, Application Inventory, live collaboration sessions, Spec Hub governance UI) has a 1:1 API equivalent, and community evidence is silent on this specific parity question. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or independent verification that all UI features (not just core collection/mock/env management) are exposed via API, and community corroboration of complete API coverage.
